fixture.placement_rule: Import prepared fixture at identity in part coordinates; stock top at Z0 and bottom at -25.4mm, jaw faces at Y +/-25.4mm. Place fixture base on machine table using the setup machine/workpiece transform without moving accepted CAD.
fixture.support_rule: Two Haas09-0108 152.4x12.7x38.1mm parallel envelopes included. Both rest on vise bed lands and lie outside the through-slot envelopes (including 1mm breakthrough). Drilled parallel holes omitted conservatively.
fixture.coordinate_frame: G54 stock top center; fixture already positioned relative to accepted part. Import at identity, do not re-close or re-position individual jaw components.

supports.representation: conservative solid envelopes included in fixture archive

fixture.physical_assumptions: Rigid clamping and mounting assumed for geometric simulation; cutting forces, jaw deflection and physical setup certification are outside verified coverage.

contact_review.note: Each parallel spans the vise bed center recess and is supported on two side lands; no positive-volume interference with fixture or slot envelopes. This is geometric contact evidence, not a cutting-load analysis.
